portable_panel: AAYS TerraYield Portable Kontrol Paneli - Sabit 8012
objective: Make the existing one-click runner flow self-recovering, idempotent and provable. One click must perform all required checks, keep a single shared runner, create a small real self-test file, commit and push it to GitHub, and expose a stable proof path readable by ChatGPT.
required_behavior: Use only the existing F portable shared runner. Never start a second or parallel runner.
On one click, detect an existing live PID and valid lock. If healthy, keep it and do not bootstrap another process.
If stale, validate PID age, process existence, lock ownership and heartbeat before clearing only the stale lock.
Check repository path, active branch, git status, rebase/merge state, remote reachability and write permission.
If the worktree is dirty, create a timestamped stash before pull and record the stash result.
Pull the required branch and stop with an explicit blocker if pull fails. Do not report success on failure.
Start or reuse exactly one runner, wait for a fresh heartbeat, and verify that the PID reported by the panel matches the active runner process or provide a documented parent/child PID mapping.
Run a small self-test after health passes. The self-test must create a real UTF-8 JSON file with a unique timestamp and random nonce; it must not copy a pre-existing proof.
Commit and push the self-test file to the same GitHub branch.
Update a stable latest pointer file so ChatGPT can fetch the most recent successful self-test without knowing the timestamp.
Display the final state in the portable panel: runner active, PID, heartbeat time, branch, pull status, self-test status, commit SHA and proof path.
Keep final_ready=false, product_final_ready=false, fake_data=false, db_write=false, migration=false and production_deploy=false.
acceptance_criteria: Pressing Tek Runner Başlat once either reuses one healthy runner or recovers one stale runner; it never creates a second runner.
A fresh timestamped self-test JSON is produced during that click flow.
The self-test JSON is committed and pushed to branch codex/aays-single-runner-v5-20260706.
The stable latest proof path exists and points to the new test.
GitHub fetch of the stable latest path returns the expected nonce, PID, heartbeat, commit SHA and push status.
The portable panel shows the same PID and proof path, or an explicit parent/child PID relationship.
No completed, 100 percent or final_ready=true claim is allowed unless all acceptance criteria have real GitHub proof.
